questions.question: Whom does Psalm 112 call blessed?
options: The man who fears the LORD and greatly delights in his commandments
The man who is wise in his counsel and is admired by everyone
The man who is mighty in battle and rules over many nations
The man who is rich in this present world and gives to the poor
questions.answer: The man who fears the LORD and greatly delights in his commandments

questions.question: What is said about the righteous man's heart in trouble?
options: It is proud, boasting in its great wealth and great strength
It is faint, longing for rest from its many labors
It is firm, trusting in the LORD, not afraid of bad news
It is troubled, fearing the day of disaster to come
questions.answer: It is firm, trusting in the LORD, not afraid of bad news
